notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans!

Mark your calendars—[b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b] launches on December 9th! ːlovecatː

We’re beyond excited to finally bring you this heartwarming journey set in a rural shelter filled with adorable, special-needs cats. This time, we’re introducing a peaceful, bucolic atmosphere along with an incredible new soundtrack to make the experience even more immersive. Help Hannah with the shelter and uncover more of her story too! ːwinkycatː

Whether you’re here for the playful kitties or the comforting ambiance, there’s something for every cat lover in this game. We can’t wait to share it with you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3087650/A_Shelter_Full_of_Cats/

[b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b] releases on December 9th! As always, thanks for all the love and support! 

Love and purrs,
The Devcats
